title: The Midnight Teacup
scene: At 12:10 AM, the manor's prized teacup was found shattered in the study. Inspector Quill gathered four people who were nearby. One of them is lying.

suspects.name: Mara Finch
suspects.testimony: I was in the kitchen washing pots from midnight until 12:20. I never stepped into the study.
suspects.alibiProof: Soap suds were still on her apron at 12:15, matching the kitchen sink she used.

suspects.name: Jonah Pike
suspects.testimony: I was locking the greenhouse at midnight. I heard the crash but stayed outside the whole time.
suspects.alibiProof: The greenhouse lock log shows his key turned at 12:01, and mud on his boots matches only the garden path.

suspects.name: Elise Rowe
suspects.testimony: I was in the study reading until 12:05, then left to my room. The teacup was perfectly fine when I left.
suspects.contradiction: A bookmark from the book she claimed to read was found under the shattered teacup, placed there after the cup broke.

suspects.name: Bram Cole
suspects.testimony: I was in the garage polishing the car from 11:50 to 12:30. I didn't come inside at all.
suspects.alibiProof: Oil polish on the steering wheel was still wet at 12:25, showing he had been working there continuously.
